en.title: Largest Square in Skyscraper Outline
en.description:
A row of adjacent skyscrapers each has width 1, with heights given by the array cityLine. Find the area of the largest square that lies entirely within the outline of the buildings.

Parts of the input protocol and constraints marked "site supplement" were compiled by this site and are not additional conditions of the original problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤200000), and the second line contains n non-negative integers h_i (0≤h_i≤10^9). These input ranges are site supplements; the original problem listed no constraints.
en.output: Output the maximum area of a square that fits.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules above; see the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First pin down the problem's definitions of counting, paths, or splitting, then choose a suitable graph traversal, frequency count, or dynamic programming approach.
